hypotheses.justification: This follows from `hP` and `hPQ`. The structure `ComponentChart` (Definitions/Def_AlgebraicCurve_SemistableCharts.lean) has the field `placeMap_not_mem_nodes : ∀ P ∈ dom, placeMap P ∉ nodes`. So `hPQ ▸ (C i).placeMap_not_mem_nodes P hP : Q ∉ (C i).nodes`. The proof uses `hQ` only once, as the argument of `(C i).mapDomain_placeMap ... Q hQ`, and that term can be passed there instead. This can be removed on its own, and also together with `hT0`.

This follows from `hT1`. `Q.ord` is `AlgebraicCurve.Place.ord`, defined as `-(WithZero.log (v.adicValuation f))`, and the simp lemma `Place.ord_zero : v.ord 0 = 0` (Def_AlgebraicCurve_DivisorClassGroup.lean, line 125) holds. If `(C i).residue ⟨T, hT⟩ = 0`, rewriting `hT1` gives `Q.ord 0 = 1`, i.e. `0 = 1`, which is false. So inside the proof `hT0` can be rebuilt as `fun h => by rw [h, Place.ord_zero] at hT1; exact absurd hT1 (by decide)`, and the rest of the proof is unchanged. This can be removed on its own, and also together with `hQ`.
